title: Marketing Executive
description: Marketing Executive Stewarts Automotive Group Kingston and St. Andrew Not disclosed Permanent full-time Updated 28/10/2026 HR Apply Now Share Share this job Facebook Twitter Report This Job Save Save The incumbent will assist the Marketing Manager in planning and supervising the marketing operations to achieve business objectives. Build, implement and manage marketing strategies for assigned brands across various marketing channels. The Stewart's Automotive Group is seeking a dynamic, results driven and experienced candidate to fill the post of: MARKETING EXECUTIVE Job Summary :The Brand Marketing Executive is responsible for the strategic planning, development and execution of integrated marketing initiatives designed to strengthen brand positioning, increase market visibility, generate qualified sales leads and support the achievement of business objectives.The role requires a proactive, results-driven approach, including identifying market opportunities, developing innovative campaigns and customer engagement initiatives, and monitoring performance against established KPIs. Working with the Group Marketing Manager, Sales teams and other stakeholders, the Executive ensures alignment with commercial priorities, manufacturer's guidelines and the strategic direction of Stewart’s Automotive Group. The key responsibilities of this position include: Strategic Brand Planning & Ownership Develop and maintain annual and quarterly marketing plans with SMART objectives, aligned with sales goals, business priorities and market opportunities. Proactively propose innovative campaigns, partnerships and customer engagement initiatives that strengthen brand positioning and visibility. Maintain alignment with manufacturer brand guidelines and internal brand standards. Lead Generation & Sales Alignment Develop and execute targeted marketing initiatives to generate leads and contribute to vehicle sales objectives. Collaborate with Sales Managers and Sales Executives to align activities with inventory, customer demand, sales priorities and product launches. Work with Sales and CRM teams to monitor lead quality, recording, follow-up and conversion trends, and identify improvements. Develop sales support materials and promotional initiatives in collaboration with the sales teams. Digital Marketing & Creative Direction Work with Social Media Executives, designers and other creative partners to plan integrated digital campaigns and content aligned with brand objectives. Monitor digital campaign performance, including reach, engagement and lead generation. Contribute copy and content ideas for advertising, social media, websites, brochures, emails and other marketing materials. Events, Partnerships & Customer Engagement Conceptualise, plan and execute brand activations, events and promotional campaigns to increase visibility, generate leads and build customer relationships. Identify and evaluate strategic partnerships, sponsorships and collaborative opportunities that align with brand and commercial priorities. Develop customer engagement and retention initiatives that encourage loyalty and repeat business. Liaise with vendors, media and advertising partners; negotiate services in consultation with the Group Marketing Manager and relevant leadership. Market Intelligence & Product Knowledge Maintain working knowledge of assigned vehicle portfolios, selling points, competitive advantages, target segments and manufacturer initiatives. Analyse automotive industry trends, competitor pricing, positioning, promotion and market opportunities. Use customer insights, market research, surveys and available sales data to inform campaign recommendations. Support vehicle launches and model introductions with integrated go-to-market plans. Budget, Measurement & Reporting Monitor approved marketing expenditure, maintain accurate records and promptly explain budget variances. Monitor performance against agreed KPIs and recommend corrective action where results fall below targets. Complete post-campaign and event evaluations covering expenditure, lead generation, engagement, outcomes and recommendations for improvement. Assess campaign effectiveness and seek to maximise return on marketing investment. Cross-Functional Collaboration Collaborate with Sales, CRM, Aftersales, Product and other relevant departments to support business priorities and a consistent customer experience. Coordinate effectively with internal teams and external stakeholders to deliver agreed projects and deadlines. QUALIFICATIONS & REQUIREMENTS: Bachelor’s Degree in Marketing, Business, or related fields 4-5 years of strategic marketing experience Experience with brand marketing, digital marketing and social media marketing with associated analytical skills Data-driven with strong analytical skills and good problem-solving abilities. Good time management skills – ability to organize, prioritize and manage multiple projects with overlapping goals and objectives. Innovative, forward-thinking and willing to work enthusiastically to take on many responsibilities. Adaptable and flexible – responsive and resourceful in a fast-paced environment. Exceptional verbal and written communication skills. Actively listens and participates within a team environment. Knowledge of the latest industry trends and best practices in automotive marketing Highly creative, with experience in identifying target audiences and devising brand campaigns that delight, engage, inform, and motivate. Possession of a reliable motor vehicle and valid driver’s license. WORKING ENVIRONMENT May be required to work beyond normal working hours and on weekends from time to time. Will be required to work in office environments, at customer events and in the general public environment Ref: Marketing Executive Apply Now
